summary: Verified the empty-options root-cause fix (DISABLE_VISUAL_EDITS=true). All key <select> elements site-wide contain ONLY <option> direct children — no <span data-ve-dynamic> wrappers, no [x-component] or [data-ve-dynamic] attributes anywhere in the DOM. Section counts, form validation, and regression smoke all pass. Previously-reported React DOM-nesting warning ('<span> cannot appear as a child of <option>/<select>') is GONE from the console.
critical_code_review_comments: craco.config.js correctly gates enableVisualEdits on DISABLE_VISUAL_EDITS !== 'true' AND isDevServer — fix is production-safe.

Minor: gradebook create modal — grade select has required=false while section is required=true. If both are business-required, add required to grade select (currently a default value avoids the issue). Not part of this bug.
seed_data_creation: None — form validation blocked the only submission attempt; no DB writes occurred.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Visual-edits instrumentation is fully disabled. If DISABLE_VISUAL_EDITS is ever removed or set to false, span wrappers will return and Safari will show empty dropdowns again. Keep DISABLE_VISUAL_EDITS=true in frontend/.env.
